questions.question: What colors are the signs that show the distance to the next highway exit?

options.text: Yellow with black letters
Black with white letters
Red with white letters
Green with white letters

questions.correctAnswerText: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Signs that show destinations are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes going your direction, which lane should you use?

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.
The lane marked with an arrow.
The middle lane.
Any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane that is closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: Your body removes about how much alcohol per hour?

options.text: Three drinks per hour.
One drink per hour.
Two drinks per hour.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: One drink per hour.
questions.explanation: Most people's bodies process about one drink per hour. However, how impaired you become depends on many things: how much you drink, how fast you drink, your body weight, whether you have eaten, and your overall health.

questions.question: A car is coming at you head-on in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.
Honk, steer left, and brake.
Honk, steer right, and brake.
Stay in the center of your lane, honk, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First, honk to get the other driver's attention. If they don't move, try to escape to the right. Steering left is risky because if the other driver corrects, you will still crash. Brake hard and steady. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the impact of a collision.

questions.question: What color are the road markings between traffic lanes going in opposite directions?

options.text: Yellow
White
Yellow and white
Yellow, white, and black

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge into traffic. Slow down to 35 mph.
A winding road is ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: You are driving on a slippery road and need to slow down. What should you do first?

options.text: Brake hard.
Release the gas pedal.
Use the parking brake.
Pump the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: First, take your foot off the gas pedal. If you need to slow down more, gently apply steady pressure to the brake pedal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn to the right.
Two curves in a row.
A winding road.
The pavement ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: A winding road.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through carefully. You don't always have to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians pass first. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: What are regulatory signs?

options.text: They are placed everywhere there is a present danger.
They tell you what you must or must not do.
They are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
They warn you about school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: They tell you what you must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black markings on white. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, no passing zones, no turns, and other driving rules.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A left curve is ahead.
A series of curves is ahead.
An S-curve is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: If two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, what should happen?

options.text: The largest vehicle has the right-of-way.
The car on the left has the right-of-way.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at the same time at an uncontrolled intersection, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When may you use your horn?

options.text: When you have to stop quickly.
When you are passing another car.
When you have lost control of your car.
When you are passing a bicyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you have lost control of your car.
questions.explanation: Use your horn if you lose control of your vehicle. This alerts other drivers to danger.

questions.question: How should you always think about railroad crossings?

options.text: They are safe to cross because trains rarely come.
They are dangerous.
They are safe places to park.
You must always stop there.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are dangerous.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and directions from flaggers. Only cross when you are certain it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Narrow bridge ahead.
A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
Industrial area ahead.
Freeway on-ramp ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
U-turns are not allowed.
You may go if the way is clear.
Stop completely before going forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: On a two-lane road, you may pass when there is a single solid yellow line on your side of the center line.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: You may only pass when the broken yellow line is on your side of the center line. A solid yellow line on your side means no passing.

questions.question: When is it not allowed to cross a single broken white or yellow line?

options.text: When it would interfere with traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car in front is broken down.
When passing on the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it would interfere with traffic.
questions.explanation: You may cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if you can do so safely and without interfering with other traffic.

questions.question: What is the speed limit on interstate highways in rural areas?

options.text: 50 mph
60 mph
70 mph
80 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 70 mph
questions.explanation: The maximum speed limit on interstate highways is 70 mph.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, what should you do?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill with a curb, turn your front wheels away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will roll into the curb, not into traffic.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:

options.text: Solid red light.
Stop sign.
Yield sign.
Caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: If a car coming toward you has high beams on, look toward the ____ of the road.

options.text: Either side
The center
The right side
The left side

questions.correctAnswerText: The right side
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded by the other car's headlights. You can then see enough to stay on your path until the car passes.

questions.question: A speed limit is:

options.text: The fastest or slowest legal speed you can drive in bad conditions.
The fastest or slowest legal speed you can drive in good conditions.
The suggested speed to drive in good conditions.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest or slowest legal speed you can drive in good conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the fastest or slowest legal speed you can drive in good conditions. You can drive slower than the posted speed, but you cannot drive faster. Drive slower in school zones, work zones, or if conditions like bad weather or road construction make the posted speed unsafe.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing without signal lights?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down and get ready to stop. Look both ways to make sure no trains are coming on any track. If you see or hear a train, stop a safe distance away from the tracks and wait until it passes.

questions.question: A speed restriction sign:

options.text: Can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
Has a triangular shape.
Is blue with black letters.
Shows a suggested speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows a suggested speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Signs for curves and turns often show a suggested speed for that area. You might feel safe going faster in good weather, but never do this in rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: If a traffic light shows both red and a green arrow, a driver can turn in the direction of the arrow even though the red light is still on.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: You can turn in the direction of a green arrow after you let other traffic go through the intersection or crosswalk. You do not have to wait for the red light to change.

questions.question: You want to turn left at a green light, but traffic is coming toward you. What should you do?

options.text: Use the next intersection.
Wait at the edge of the intersection for traffic to pass.
Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to pass.
Turn now because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to pass.
questions.explanation: Wait for traffic to pass before turning left. You can enter the intersection to get ready for your turn if the light is green and no other car ahead of you is turning left.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers:

options.text: When leaving a garage or alley to enter a street.
When a car on your left reaches an unmarked intersection at the same time as you.
When your traffic light is a green arrow.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: When leaving a garage or alley to enter a street.
questions.explanation: You must yield to other drivers when leaving an alley, driveway, or garage. You must also yield to pedestrians on a crossing sidewalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill is ahead.
You must turn left.
Do not enter.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A four-way intersection is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: A solid white line down the middle of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means drivers cannot pass.
